### Joy and Comfort in Christ
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/joy-and-comfort-christ
Passage: Philemon 1:7
Points:
- Paul deeply valued Philemon as a brother whose sincere love brought joy and consolation.
- Philemon's care refreshed fellow Christians through practical acts of discipleship, encouragement, and prayer.
- Engaging Scripture honestly means grappling with historical contexts and complexities without compromising biblical truth.
- Believers should avoid whitewashing the flaws of past Christians while recognizing that no one applies the gospel perfectly.
